title: Engine Compilation Configuration Editor crashes when scanning compressed resources
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in all tested versions: 4.4.1, 4.7.1, 4.8dev3, latest master branch rev 63b7e0272


### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - macOS Tahoe (26.5.2) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M4 Pro - Apple M4 Pro (14 threads) - 48.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When scanning the project via the Engine Compilation Configuration Editor's `Detect from Project` button, the editor can crash if the project contains any resource files saved as binary with compression enabled.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a scene or resource file containing at least one embedded resource (see attached MRP for a reliable example)
2. Ensure it is saved as binary (i.e. `.scn` or `.res`) and with compression enabled (i.e. the editor setting `FileSystem/On Save/Compress Binary Resources` is enabled)
3. Open `Project/Tools/Engine Compilation Configuration Editor...` and click Detect from Project
4. Observe symptoms of heap corruption (e.g. invalid unicode messages in the console, instant crash, crash when repeating steps, running a custom build with address sanitiser enabled, etc.)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[engine-compilation-scan-crash-example.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31067342/engine-compilation-scan-crash-example.zip)
